question: List Esophageal/GEJ trials requiring a biomarker other than PD‑L1 for inclusion.

gemini.answer: Esophageal/GEJ trials using biomarkers other than PD-L1 for inclusion.
gemini.assumptions: Trials requiring only other biomarkers will have "other_biomarker_inclusion" = 'Yes' AND "pdl1_inclusion" = 'No'.
gemini.raw: {"sql":"SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\", \"cancer_type\", \"other_biomarker_inclusion\"\nFROM public.\"clinical_trials\"\nWHERE \"cancer_type\" = 'Esophageal/GEJ' AND \"other_biomarker_inclusion\" = 'Yes' AND \"pdl1_inclusion\" = 'No';", "answer": "Esophageal/GEJ trials using biomarkers other than PD-L1 for inclusion.", "assumptions": "Trials requiring only other biomarkers will have \"other_biomarker_inclusion\" = 'Yes' AND \"pdl1_inclusion\" = 'No'."}
